name: use-hpc
description: From source code and a paper to audited GPU experiments on Slurm: scaffolds hpc/ with an experiment graph (job arrays, afterok/afterany/aftercorr dependencies, needs/produces data contracts), a GPU-only guard, self-requeue, smoke runs, a live tabular audit, results collection (CSV, Markdown/LaTeX tables, figures, logs) and a guide mapping every experiment of the paper to the job that runs it.
